notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a black permanent.
Your life total is five or less.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Reap without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Reap, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
